component.name: Vibezeo
component.summary: A desktop workspace for coding-agent CLIs

description.p: Vibezeo runs the coding-agent command-line tools you already use (such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI) side by side in terminals and threads, with approvals, git and files in one window.
It works offline on the Free plan. Nothing leaves your computer unless you turn on a hosted feature.
